notes.title: Evolution of Species 2: Theme parties and player creativity!
notes.notes:
Evolution of Species 2 is a game that allows players to become gods and create their own creatures from scratch. You are given the opportunity to choose the shape, abilities and behavior of your creations, and then watch them evolve and adapt to the world around them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45261924/7b9c8bda872812c64ee911083640a914694ed13e.jpg[/img]

However, the developers of Evolution of Species 2 did not limit themselves to creating a fascinating game world. They also created a unique system of theme parties that are regularly held in the game. These parties offer players to participate in creative contests and competitions related to a certain topic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45261924/110ec94a314181bbed21d1a40319e183c71132e3.jpg[/img]

Parties in Evolution of Species 2 are held once every two weeks and each time offer a new and exciting theme. Players have already tried themselves in the roles of creators of creatures from different universes! This allows you to immerse yourself in the worlds of your favorite films, books and comics, creating unique characters that could exist in these worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45261924/3c62b738a6a7d3ff10531e6d5c461fb068a9315a.jpg[/img]

To make participating in parties even more exciting, the developers have provided various rewards. For winning a party, players can receive DNA points, which allow them to develop their creatures and make them more unique and powerful.

If you haven't tried your hand at "Evolution of Species 2" and participating in themed parties yet, then perhaps it's time to join this exciting community and start creating your own unique creatures!
